{{Top|leg}}
The '''Useani camnzin''' was apparently a creature native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Usean II]]. The camnzin was said to be a mountain dweller responsible for wiping out several herbivorous species. In reality, it was a hoax perpetrated by [[Wilek Nereus]]. Nereus collected animal [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]], including a set from a herbivore from Usean II, the [[lrashtash]]. the teeth were often mistaken as those of a predator, so it amused Nereus to invent a species for his own entertainment.
